matches.name: Set.Finite
matches.docstring:
A set is finite if the corresponding `Subtype` is finite,
i.e., if there exists a natural `n : ℕ` and an equivalence `s ≃ Fin n`.

matches.name: Function.mem_periodicPts_iff_isPeriodicPt_factorial_card
matches.signature:
theorem mem_periodicPts_iff_isPeriodicPt_factorial_card [Fintype α] :
    x ∈ periodicPts f ↔ IsPeriodicPt f (card α)! x

matches.name: Set.fintypeSeq'
matches.signature:
instance fintypeSeq' {α β : Type u} [DecidableEq β] (f : Set (α → β)) (s : Set α) [Fintype f]
    [Fintype s] : Fintype (f <*> s)

matches.name: Filter.Eventually
matches.signature: def Eventually (p : α → Prop) (f : Filter α) : Prop
matches.docstring:
`f.Eventually p` or `∀ᶠ x in f, p x` mean that `{x | p x} ∈ f`. E.g., `∀ᶠ x in atTop, p x`
means that `p` holds true for sufficiently large `x`.
